items.q: Did you feel it that night at Birdland with Helen ? ... I knew then that we was really -- that we were really swinging

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And let me see, Helen did another thing, 'Don't Worry About Me,' that sold quite a bit. That was one of Helen's things. And they sold quite a bit.
